# Page 1^page=1
Strategy to write a conclusion Email:mockmentorofficial@gmail.com Telegram: Mockmentor Website: www.mockmentor.in 1 Universal Conclusion Formula Think of every conclusion in 3 simple steps: 1) Where are we now? (Progress / Status) 2) What is still missing? (Problem / Gap) 3) What should be done? (Way Forward / Solution) Meaning you should always consider (Present → Problem → Path Ahead) while writing a conclusion. Now we will try to understand how to write topic wise conclusion to enhance our writing skill. 1) Economic and Social Issues Progress → Gaps → Action → Inclusive Goal Template: “India has achieved ______, but ______ persists, therefore ______ is needed to ensure inclusive and sustainable growth.” 2) Finance Strength → Risk → Reform Template: “The financial system is stronger with ______, however ______ risks remain, thus ______ reforms are essential.” 3) Management Improvement → Challenge → Fix Template: “While organisations have improved in ______, challenges like ______ remain, hence ______ is required.” Generic (Use in any answer) Now → Issue → Need Template: “Although ______, ______ continues to be a concern, therefore ______ is necessary.” How to Fill the Blanks Since 1st Blank is talking about the Progress element, you must Use positive words. Example words: improved, strengthened, growing, expanding Example: “India’s growth remains robust…” 2nd Blank is talking about the existing Problems; means you must balance (not overly negative) while highlighting the challenges Example: however, despite this, concerns remain One-Line Template (Use Anywhere) “While ______ (progress), ______ (challenge), therefore ______ (way forward)

# Page 2^page=2
Strategy to write a conclusion Email:mockmentorofficial@gmail.com Telegram: Mockmentor Website: www.mockmentor.in 2 3rd Blank is a Way Forward, hence Use solution-oriented words • Example: therefore, thus, hence, going forward Example “India continues to be one of the fastest-growing major economies, however global uncertainties and structural challenges persist, therefore strengthening domestic demand and policy reforms will be key to a sustainable long-term growth.” Note -The above templates are only guiding frameworks, not fixed answers. Your conclusion should be tailored to the specific demand of the question. Wherever possible, briefly reflect important ideas or factors discussed in the main body of your answer as this will give your conclusion a logical direction. Avoid introducing new points; instead, synthesise what you have already written into a concise, forward-looking closing. Conclusion and Introduction must be balanced in nature means both not exceeding 10% of your word limit. If the required word limit is 620 words then your intro and conclusion must be of 60 words (max) each.
